subject: Christmas Special
overview: Host Laura Duggan presented the 2025 Christmas special of Looking Back at Medford History, featuring a North Pole sketch where Santa's brothers temporarily manage holiday preparations during Santa's vacation. The episode concluded with a musical performance and a reading of 'The Night Before Christmas.'

items.title: Host Introduction and Departure for the North Pole
items.summary: Host Laura Duggan opens the 2025 Christmas special and uses a travel app to journey to the North Pole.

items.title: Visit with Santa and Arrival of the Claus Brothers
items.summary: Duggan delivers cookies and a wish list to Santa and Mrs. Claus before Santa's brothers, Elvis and Brady, arrive for a visit.

items.title: Santa's Vacation and Workshop Handover
items.summary: Santa and Mrs. Claus depart for a one-week vacation to Hawaii, leaving Elvis and Brady in charge of workshop preparations.

items.title: Workshop Difficulties and Outside Assistance
items.summary: After the brothers struggle with gift wrapping and inadvertently let the reindeer loose, Duggan arranges outside help to keep preparations on schedule.

items.title: Santa's Return and 'Blue Christmas' Performance
items.summary: Santa and Mrs. Claus return to the North Pole to find the preparations completed, and the brothers perform the song 'Blue Christmas.'

items.title: Reading of 'The Night Before Christmas'
items.summary: Duggan concludes the holiday broadcast with a reading of Clement C. Moore's 'The Night Before Christmas.'
